results.claim: Mentions that some expense lines were zero in Jun 2026 after being non-zero in prior months, naming at least two of: Advisory Services, Federal & State Taxes, Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous, Professional Fees.
results.evidence: The commentary says "Four expense lines (Advisory Services, Federal & State Taxes, Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous, Professional Fees) were zero in Jun 2026 after averaging...". It names all four lines, and the reference facts show each had a non-zero prior average.

results.claim: Every figure given for those lines' prior averages (individually or as a range) satisfies the rounding policy. If no such figures are given, this claim PASSES.
results.evidence: The commentary gives a range of "roughly 500-1,250". The true averages run from 721.0 (Marketing Misc) to 1,250 (Advisory). The low end of 500 is about 31% below 721, which is outside the 5% band.

results.claim: States as fact a reason those lines went to zero (e.g. contract ended, cost cutting, vendor dropped).
results.evidence: The commentary says "This is because those vendor contracts ended in May." That states a cause as fact, and the reference facts support no such cause.

results.claim: Describes those lines as permanently discontinued or cancelled without leaving it to the reviewer.
results.evidence: "those vendor contracts ended in May" presents the lines as permanently ended. It does not leave the question of discontinuation to the reviewer.
